title: Croatia looking to hire 785 Filipinos for hotel jobs

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — At least 785 jobs in Croatia’s hospitality industry have opened to Filipino workers under a government-to-government recruitment program, with 943 applicants shortlisted for interviews, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said on Tuesday. The two-day recruitment activity began on Monday in Mandaluyong City, where representatives of nine Croatian hotel employers conducted interviews
